newsitem.title: USA: King World Productions COO leaves company.
newsitem.headline: King World Productions COO leaves company.

text.p: King World Productions Inc said Stephen Palley, its executive vice president and chief operating officer, has left the Company concurrent with the August 31, 1996 expiration of his employment contract.
In accordance with that understanding, the company said Palley also resigned his position as a member of the board.

King World said Palley will continue to serve as a consultant through December 31 and will assist in the orderly transition of his responsibilities. In the interim, Michael King, King World's president and chief executive, will serve as acting chief operating officer, King World said.
The company said the board has formed a committee to find a permanent successor for Palley.
